system.description:
Prerequisites: Basic Fortitude or Potence, Intermediate Presence. Through a dramatic, clearly witnessed display of physical prowess or fearlessness in the face of danger, the anarch rallies up to three allies within line of sight to fight on rather than flee. The player makes a Social Test against a difficulty of seven Traits, retested with Leadership; each chosen ally gains an extra Courage Trait for the remainder of the fight (converted to temporary Willpower if it would exceed the Virtue Trait maximum). It cannot be used on the wielder himself, nor more than once on the same target per combat, though multiple different allies may benefit in the same use.

Costs 6 Experience Traits to learn.
